data.body:
[P2] Recheck marker outcomes as well as marker identities

Reconciliation retains only marker IDs. A cleanup history can change the existing `record-marker` step's status or stored result without a finding, even when settlement is inside the observation window and the execution-level result remains correct. The common history check compares execution-level expectations, and the final audit uses frozen operations, so neither catches the failed isolation assertion. Check every supplied marker status and result against the frozen marker and fixture expectation, allowing omitted fields in partial snapshots, and add a regression that changes only the marker outcome.
